Standard operating procedure

Forms and Notifications: Creating a New Data Collection

Follow these steps to build a form, publish a notification that points teachers to it, and check that the notification reaches the app.

How to know where to click: every screenshot has red boxes with numbers. Each box marks the exact button or link to press, and the line under the step says which number to press. Tap any screenshot to enlarge it.

  • Overview
  • Part 0: Prepare
  • Part A: Form
  • Part B: Notification
  • Part C: Validate
  • Checklist

Overview

A new collection has two parts. The form holds the questions. The notification announces the form to schools and links to it. Create the form first, because the notification needs the form's link.

V-login

Used for forms

Sign in with the district V-login to create forms (Part A).

D-login

Used for notifications

Sign in with the district D-login only for notifications (Part B). Do not use the V-login here.

Credentials

Every district's logins and passwords are in the user-structure sheet (opens in Google Sheets). Do not paste logins or passwords into tickets, chats or this document.

Part 0

Prepare from the ticket

Start from the ticket. The Excel file in the ticket is the reference for every field you will enter.

  1. P1

    Open or create the ticket

    Create the ticket in Nimble for the new form. Its description states the purpose and the owners.

  2. P2

    Download the form Excel from the ticket

    Open the Comments & Attachments tab. Download the Excel file for the form.

  3. P3

    Check whether a previous form covers the same class

    Compare the new Excel with the previous one shared in the ticket. If the form is for the same class, reuse its structure and update only what has changed.

  4. P4

    Update the fields to the required format

    Modify the form fields as the conditional format in the Excel requires. Check that every field is in the correct format before you start building on the portal.

    Tip

    Check every field against the Excel before you move on. Fixing a field after the form is live is harder than fixing it now.

Part A

Create the form

Sign in with the V-login and build the form question by question.

  1. A1

    Sign in to the portal

    Go to ticklinks.com and sign in with the district V-login. Find the login details in the user-structure sheet.

  2. A2

    Open the Forms (प्रपत्र) tab

    Scroll down the subject list and open प्रपत्र - (फॉर्म्स), labelled 1 - प्रपत्र - (फॉर्म्स).

    Where to clickThe red box on the 1 - प्रपत्र - (फॉर्म्स) folder.

  3. A3

    Select the month and click Continue

    Find the month you are building the form for. This is usually the current month. Click Continue on that row.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the CONTINUE button on the 41.नवंबर 2026 row.

  4. A4

    Click "click here" to add a resource

    In the top-right panel, click click here next to "To add your resource". The Add Private Link window opens.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the blue click here link in the right-hand panel, next to "To add your resource".

  5. A5

    Choose Form, then fill in the form details

    In the Add Private Link window, click Form. Fill in the details exactly as the Excel from the ticket states them, then click Next.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Form icon, the bottom-right option.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Next button at the bottom right.

  6. A6

    Add the questions

    On the question screen, open the Question Type dropdown and select the type (for example, Short Answer Question). Click + Add Question.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the + Add Question link.

  7. A7

    Complete each question and save it

    In the Add Short Answer Question window:

    • Type the question text (in मराठी or Hindi where the form is in that language).
    • Tick Mandatory if the question is required. The "Mark all questions as Mandatory" box is ticked by default on the question screen.
    • Tick Allow to add media only if the Excel asks for it.
    • Set the Answer Type, for example Numeric.
    • Click Save to go on to the next question.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Mandatory tick. Marker 2: the Save button, which saves this question.

    Important

    Click the form-level Save only after every question has been added and saved. Saving early leaves out questions.

  8. A8

    Find the saved form and copy its link

    After you save, the form appears in the Forms tab. Select it to open the form, then click the Share icon and copy the link.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Share icon at the top of the form. Marker 2: Click to Copy Link.

    Keep this link

    Paste the copied form link into a safe place now. You will need it in Part B, step B6.

Part B

Create the notification

Sign in with the D-login and publish a notification that links to the form from Part A.

  1. B1

    Sign in with the D-login

    Go to ticklinks.com and sign in with the district D-login. Notifications are created with the D-login only.

    The D-login for each district is listed in the user-structure sheet.
  2. B2

    Open the Monthly Notification (मासिक सूचना) tab

    Scroll down and open मासिक सूचना, for example 1 - मासिक सूचना- देव दुर्ग.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the 1 - मासिक सूचना- देव दुर्ग folder.

  3. B3

    Select the month and click Continue

    Find the month you are publishing for (usually the current month) and click Continue.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the CONTINUE button on the नवंबर 2026 row.

  4. B4

    Click "click here" and choose NOTE

    In the right-hand panel, click click here next to "To add your resource". In the Add Private Link window, click NOTE.

    Where to clickMarker 1 on the left: click here. Marker 1 on the right: the NOTE icon.

  5. B5

    Write the note and click Next

    Choose the type of notification. Fill in the Title and Description, choose the section and period, and set visibility (for example, "Available for ... school"). Click Next.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Next button at the bottom right.

    Title example from the screenshots: मासिक परीक्षा परिणाम - कक्षा 8 वीं (Monthly exam result, Class 8).
  6. B6

    Set the dates and link the form

    • Tick Notification.
    • Tick Date Control and set the start and end dates.
    • Fill in the Title and Sub Title.
    • Under Call for action, select Form Link, then paste the link copied in step A8.
    • Under See Notification in, select Forms.
    • Set the alert, and choose the school and ownership types that the Excel asks for.
    • Click Save.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Date Control tick. Marker 2: the Form Link option, then paste the link below it. Marker 3: Save.

    Check before you save

    Confirm the start and end dates, and that the pasted link is the form you created in Part A.

  7. B7

    Confirm the notification is listed

    After you click Save, the notification appears under the month's list of resources.

Part C

Validate in the app

Check the result the way schools will see it.

  1. C1

    Open the Forms section in the app

    Open the app, go to the Teacher Story tab, and tap the Forms chip.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the Forms chip.

  2. C2

    Confirm the notification and open the form

    Find your notification in the Forms feed. Check the title, the date, and the call-to-action link, then tap it to confirm that it opens the correct form.

    Where to clickMarker 1: the call-to-action link under the notification. It opens the form.

    If it fails

    If the notification is missing or the link opens the wrong form, correct the notification in Part B and check again. Note the problem on the ticket.

Completion checklist

Use this before you close the ticket.

Terms

Form
The set of questions schools answer. Created in Part A.
Notification
The announcement that tells schools about the form, with a link to it. Created in Part B.
V-login / D-login
The district accounts. V-login creates forms. D-login creates notifications.
Share link
The form link copied from the Share menu. It goes into the notification.
Date control
The start and end dates during which the notification is shown.
Mandatory
A question that must be answered before the form can be submitted.

Source: "New SOP forms" walkthrough deck, plus the annotated screenshot supplied for steps A3 to A5. Login screens are left out because they show credentials. Logins are kept in the user-structure sheet.
